svg.title: What survives of the ancient authors the Nobel Committee names
svg.desc: An ink bookshelf, one mark per play or book at the modern estimate: Sophocles 7 of more than 120, Euripides 18 or 19 of about 90, Aeschylus 7 (one disputed) of 70 to 90, Stesichoros 26 books in fragments, Sappho 8 or 9 books in fragments, Catullus one book through one lost manuscript, Thucydides all 8 books but unfinished. Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research.
